description: Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.

d.request: Filter fee records where `feerate` is greater than or equal to 0.0009, join to orders via exact text match on `orderslink` and `recordvault` (excluding unmatched fees), group by the pairing of `orderslink` and `dealedge` to calculate each group's average net fee rate (`feerate` minus `rebrate`, excluding nulls) and record count, then for each distinct `dealedge` value compute the mean of its constituent groups' average net fee rates, filter to groups whose average net fee rate exceeds their side's average, and return `orderslink`, `dealedge`, group average net fee rate, group record count, and the difference between group and side average—sorted descending by difference with null differences last, limited to top 10 rows, with no rounding applied.
d.sql: WITH filtered_fees AS (SELECT f.*, o.dealedge FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, dealedge, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS group_avg_net_fee, COUNT(*) AS group_record_count FROM filtered_fees GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge), side_stats AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(group_avg_net_fee) AS side_avg_net_fee FROM group_stats GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT gs.orderslink, gs.dealedge, gs.group_avg_net_fee, gs.group_record_count, gs.group_avg_net_fee - ss.side_avg_net_fee AS difference FROM group_stats gs INNER JOIN side_stats ss ON gs.dealedge = ss.dealedge WHERE gs.group_avg_net_fee > ss.side_avg_net_fee ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

b.request: Filter fees where feerate >= 0.0009, match to orders by orderslink = recordvault (excluding unmatched), group by (orderslink, dealedge) and calculate average net fee (feerate - rebrate, ignoring nulls) with record count, then for each dealedge compute the mean of those group averages, select groups exceeding their dealedge's mean, display orderslink, dealedge, group net fee average, count, and excess over side mean, sort excess descending with nulls last, limit 10, no rounding.
b.sql: WITH filtered_fees AS (SELECT orderslink, feerate, rebrate FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009), matched AS (SELECT ff.orderslink, ff.feerate, ff.rebrate, o.dealedge FROM filtered_fees ff INNER JOIN orders o ON ff.orderslink = o.recordvault), group_avg AS (SELECT orderslink, dealedge, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as group_avg_net_fee, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM matched GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge), dealedge_mean AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(group_avg_net_fee) as mean_fee FROM group_avg GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT ga.orderslink, ga.dealedge, ga.group_avg_net_fee, ga.record_count, ga.group_avg_net_fee - dm.mean_fee as excess FROM group_avg ga JOIN dealedge_mean dm ON ga.dealedge = dm.dealedge WHERE ga.group_avg_net_fee > dm.mean_fee ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
b.raw: Filter fees where feerate >= 0.0009, match to orders by orderslink = recordvault (excluding unmatched), group by (orderslink, dealedge) and calculate average net fee (feerate - rebrate, ignoring nulls) with record count, then for each dealedge compute the mean of those group averages, select groups exceeding their dealedge's mean, display orderslink, dealedge, group net fee average, count, and excess over side mean, sort excess descending with nulls last, limit 10, no rounding.

a.request: Take fee records with a fee rate (`feerate`) of at least 0.0009 and match each to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and order side (`dealedge`), compute the average net fee rate (`feerate` minus `rebrate`, ignoring missing values) and the number of records. Then compute each side's average of those group averages. List the groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than their side's average. Show `orderslink`, side, the group's average net fee rate, its record count, and the group average minus the side average. Sort by that difference from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round anything.
a.sql:
WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT f.*, o.dealedge
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    dealedge,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    dealedge,
    AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM group_averages
  GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT 
  ga.orderslink,
  ga.dealedge AS side,
  ga.avg_net_fee_rate,
  ga.record_count,
  (ga.avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg_net_fee_rate) AS difference
FROM group_averages ga
JOIN side_averages sa ON ga.dealedge = sa.dealedge
WHERE ga.avg_net_fee_rate > sa.side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

c.request: Using only high-rate fee records, with 0.0009 on the fee rate (`feerate`) as the cutoff, match each fee to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and order side (`dealedge`), compute the average net fee rate (`feerate` minus `rebrate`, ignoring missing values) and the number of records. Then compute each side's average of those group averages. List the groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than their side's average. Show `orderslink`, side, the group's average net fee rate, its record count, and the group average minus the side average. Sort by that difference from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round anything. Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.
c.sql: WITH high_rate_fees AS (SELECT f.feesnode, f.orderslink, f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.dealedge FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, dealedge, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as group_avg_net_fee, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM high_rate_fees GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge), side_averages AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(group_avg_net_fee) as side_avg FROM group_stats GROUP BY dealedge), filtered_groups AS (SELECT g.orderslink, g.dealedge, g.group_avg_net_fee, g.record_count, (g.group_avg_net_fee - s.side_avg) as difference FROM group_stats g JOIN side_averages s ON g.dealedge = s.dealedge WHERE g.group_avg_net_fee > s.side_avg) SELECT orderslink, dealedge, group_avg_net_fee, record_count, difference FROM filtered_groups ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
